sonnet.problem: The card opens with "Later, Jesus is sitting on the Mount of Olives." Verse 3 says only "While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives," and gives no time gap, so "Later" adds one.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: Card 19 already asked about verse 14 and showed the answer: the gospel will be preached in all the world. Card 20 then retells that same content ("In all the world, as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come") instead of being just the closing line.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
